isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged Equatorial Guinea lexicon here. Annobonese and Pichi are separate datasets under this folder. Do not copy between them. Annobonese is not Forro. Pichi is not Krio.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query a named language folder under data/equatorialguinea_dataset/. A merged Equatorial Guinea lexicon is not stored at this path.

license.source_extracts: Cited academic sources retain their original terms. See each language sources.md.

extraction_notes: Parent index of Equatorial Guinea languages. Lexicon is stored only in the language folders, and only from sources that name that language.
